source.notes: Typeset paper in booklet (two-up) layout rendered as page images; no usable text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark; OCR corrected against the page images. PDF page 1 holds printed page 1 (right half; left half blank), PDF page 2 holds printed pages 4 | 3, PDF page 3 holds printed pages 2 | 5; questions are filed in printed order with their PDF page. Printed header: Quarterly Examination - 2018-19, BIOLOGY, Class : VIII, Time : 2 Hrs. 15 mints, Full Marks : 80; examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed academic year (file name also says 2019). No school name printed. Section A (Compulsory) 40 marks; Section B 40 marks, attempt any four of five, so entries add to 90. Section A sub-questions A–H carry only a group mark and are kept as one entry each (Q1 A is five MCQs under one (5), kept as one entry with the options in the text). Q6 a. prints fractional marks (3½, 1, 1½) and is kept as one 6-mark entry. No answer key.

questions.sectionTitle: Section A (Compulsory) - 40 Marks
questions.text:
Multiple choice question :
i. Raisins swell when put in :
a. mustard oil b. rain water c. saline water d. saturated sugar solution
ii. Ascent of sap in plants takes place through :
a. xylem b. cartex c. epidermis d. phloem
iii. Which of the following is a rhizome?
a. potato b. ginger c. radish d. sweet potato
iv. Fusion of sperm and ovum is known as :
a. copulation b. inculation c. fertilization d. maturation
v. Reproductive whorls of flowers are :
a. sepal and stamens b. stamens and carpels c. sepals and petals d. petals and carpels
extractionIssues: OCR text corrected against the page image
Only a group total is printed for these items; kept as one entry (five MCQs under one (5)); options kept in the text
'cartex' and 'inculation' as printed
